title: Multiple and random DASH Pod BT disconnect (pump unreachable)
body:
This issue started in Dev-L on May 30th.  It was intermittent but happens daily now.  Phone is Pixel Pro 6 with no new apps, connections or software updates.  Like I said, Dev-K was working perfect.  Also to note, Pixel Pro 6 has always been slow to connect but past 3-4 months, I have never lost a pod and have 90+% connection rate.  I would never get pump unreachable until May 30th.  Updated to Dev-L build c288971008 on June 6th,

Please see logs.  Last successful connection was 13:24:18 where it handshaked after 114 seconds.  At 13.27:27 it started to communicate again, at 13:29:26 it timed out (more than 120 sec).  From that point on, it could never connect again, until I restarted my phone.  I have pump unreachable set for 1 hour so around 14:30 I restarted phone after notification and was able to reconnect.  I cleared BT Cache as well and will update if this helps.
[BT disconnect log.txt](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/8847037/BT.disconnect.log.txt)

comments.body:
@MilosKozak @avereha another time out and would not connect.  18:15:34, I started a bolus wizard after dinner to top up my insulin.  timed out.  then from there would not connect until I rebooted my phone 18:25:00.

Like I mentioned, no new apps were installed, no new devices in the house to cause "issues"
[BT disconnect log2.txt](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/8848647/BT.disconnect.log2.txt)
.  Something has changed and as of right now, I am losing connection every several hours.  Any help would be appreciated.

Another last night a 05:47:22.  I wondered if this one was due to Play Protect shutting down AAPS (never has done that before) but the time is very close to when Google said PP was run.  I cannot find any log events showing AAPS crashed around this time so might not be related.  Either way, at this time, could not connect to pump.  At 05:49:22 "connection not possible".  restarted phone at 7:30 and it reconnected.  @avereha @MilosKozak
[BT disconnect log3.txt](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/8861807/BT.disconnect.log3.txt)
Past 7 days, no disconnects so not sure what was going on.  will close the issue.
